releases.title: Today at a glance

highlights.title: A widget that matches
highlights.text: The logo, the child's name and the lesson now or next, in the frame all the apps share.

lt.title: Valdiklis kaip visų
lt.text: Logotipas, vaiko vardas ir dabartinė ar kita pamoka, tame pačiame rėmelyje kaip kitų programų.

highlights.title: The day in one look
highlights.text: Homework due tomorrow, today's messages and the lessons left, with no grades or message text.

lt.title: Diena vienu žvilgsniu
lt.text: Rytojaus namų darbai, šiandienos žinutės ir likusios pamokos, be pažymių ir žinučių teksto.

highlights.title: One widget per child
highlights.text: Type a child's name in the widget's Parameter; old data shows when it was updated.

lt.title: Valdiklis kiekvienam vaikui
lt.text: Įrašykite vaiko vardą valdiklio parametre; seni duomenys rodo, kada atnaujinti.

changes: Home Screen widget redrawn in the shared widget frame (app-blueprints · widgets 1.0.0): Dienynas+ logo tile and name on the brand's dark ground, the child's first name as a badge, the current lesson ("Now 12:15–13:00") or the next one ("Next 13:10") with the lesson after it, then homework due tomorrow (and late), today's messages (and unread) and the rest of today's lessons; the footer says how many lessons are left today
Small, medium, large and the three Lock Screen sizes; every widget string follows the app language (Lithuanian or English)
Widget parameter: a child's name picks that child when the account has more than one; each child's widget data is saved when the app shows that child

The widget keeps its own small snapshot (lesson times and subjects, homework due dates, message dates): no grades, no message text, no sign-in details; it is saved after TAMO answers in the app or in the Shortcuts check and emptied on sign-out

The widget still asks TAMO itself when its data is older than Settings › Widget › "Widget reuses data younger than", now within one TAMO request time limit in total, and shows the last snapshot when TAMO doesn't answer in time
New setting: Settings › Widget › "Mark the widget as out of date after" (12 hours by default); older data reads "⟳ Updated …" in amber
Widget runs never build the app's screen and never show an error: a problem gives "Open to sign in" or a plain "Tap to open" tile
Follows the shared widgets blueprint 1.0.0; Settings › Built with lists it

releases.title: Messages. Homework. Calm.

highlights.title: A logo of its own
highlights.text: A week calendar with a teal homework day and a blue plus on the selected day.

lt.title: Savas logotipas
lt.text: Savaitės kalendorius su žalsva namų darbų diena ir mėlynu pliusu pasirinktoje dienoje.

highlights.title: Launch screen
highlights.text: The calendar draws itself and the tagline appears for about 2 seconds; tap to skip.

lt.title: Pradžios ekranas
lt.text: Kalendorius nusipiešia ir apie 2 sekundes rodomas šūkis; paspauskite, kad praleistumėte.

highlights.title: Branded everywhere
highlights.text: The logo sits in the header, on the loading and sign-in screens and in the README.

lt.title: Logotipas visur
lt.text: Logotipas yra antraštėje, įkėlimo ir prisijungimo ekranuose bei README.

changes: New Dienynas+ logo (calendar plus): docs/logo.svg and a 1024 px app icon, docs/icon-1024.png
Launch screen shown for 2.4 s with a short animation and the tagline "Messages. Homework. Calm." ("Žinutės. Užduotys. Ramybė." in Lithuanian); tap to skip; still with Reduce Motion
Follows the shared launch-screen blueprint 1.0.0; Settings › Built with lists it
Logo mark in the header next to the child's name, the logo on the loading, sign-in and error screens, and at the top of the README
Fresh data waits for the launch screen to fade before it replaces the saved diary, so the launch screen is never cut short

releases.title: Make it yours

highlights.title: Colours and layout
highlights.text: Six colour palettes or Auto, plus Comfortable, Compact or a one-line Tiny layout.

lt.title: Spalvos ir išdėstymas
lt.text: Šešios spalvų paletės arba automatiškai, ir erdvus, glaustas ar vienos eilutės išdėstymas.

highlights.title: Text size and font
highlights.text: Pick Small to Larger text and a rounded or serif font for headings.

lt.title: Teksto dydis ir šriftas
lt.text: Pasirinkite teksto dydį ir apvalų ar serifinį antraščių šriftą.

highlights.title: All settings in one place
highlights.text: Language, grade scale, Ask, account and updates, with Reset for every number.

lt.title: Visi nustatymai vienoje vietoje
lt.text: Kalba, vertinimo skalė, „Klausk“, paskyra ir atnaujinimai, su atstatymu.

changes: New Settings sheet (sliders icon) replaces the ••• menu: Appearance, General, Grades, Ask, Account, Updates, tunables and Built with; changes apply at once
Appearance shared with the other apps: Auto plus six palettes (TAMO blue in all), Comfortable, Compact or Tiny layout, four text sizes, rounded or serif headings
Tiny layout: one line per lesson, homework item and message; tap an item to see all of it
Tunables with ranges and Reset: what Ask reads (weeks, messages, refresh age), TAMO time limit, widget refresh and cache
The Settings sheet follows the app language (Lithuanian or English)
Language and grade scales move from the Keychain to settings.json in iCloud Drive › Scriptable › DienynasPlus; your choices move over automatically
Check for updates now, in Settings › Updates
The widget uses the palette chosen in Settings
Built with: the blueprints this app follows, with links to read them

releases.title: Ask with Claude or OpenAI

highlights.title: Claude or OpenAI
highlights.text: ✨ Ask answers now work with either provider. Switch any time in AI settings.

highlights.title: Pick any model
highlights.text: Load the models your own key can use, choose one and test the connection.

highlights.title: See your token usage
highlights.text: Tokens per day, feature and model, so you always know what AI costs you.

changes: New AI settings sheet (••• › AI settings): Claude and OpenAI keys, model picker loaded from your key, connection test, token usage per day, feature and model
Keys are entered in a native secure prompt and stored in the iOS Keychain; the page only ever sees them masked
✨ Ask goes through one shared AI call, following the app-blueprints AI configuration, and keeps the whole conversation with either provider
The ✨ Ask tab stays hidden until a key is saved
Every Ask answer is labelled with the provider that wrote it
Your existing OpenAI key moves over automatically
The thinking-effort setting is gone: choose a model instead

releases.title: Never miss an update

highlights.title: Update reminders
highlights.text: The app tells you when a new version is out, and waits two days if you tap Later.

lt.title: Priminimai apie atnaujinimus
lt.text: Programa praneša apie naują versiją, o paspaudus „Vėliau“ palaukia dvi dienas.

highlights.title: One-tap update
highlights.text: Update right from the app. No need to run the installer again.

lt.title: Atnaujinimas vienu paspaudimu
lt.text: Atnaujinkite tiesiai programoje, be diegimo skripto.

highlights.title: See what's new first
highlights.text: Every update shows its three best features before you install it.

lt.title: Pirmiausia – kas naujo
lt.text: Prieš diegiant matote tris svarbiausias naujoves.

changes: Update check on start, with an update sheet showing the release's three highlights
Later, or tapping outside the sheet, snoozes the offer for two days (CONFIG.CHECK_UPDATES turns checks off)
Update now downloads the script over the running one after checking it's this app and actually newer
Version shown at the bottom of every screen
releases.json as the single source of release notes; CHANGELOG.md generated from it by tools/changelog.js
install.js installer and a shorter Install section near the top of the README

releases.title: Know the moment something's new

highlights.title: New-items alerts
highlights.text: Scheduled checks tell you about new homework, grades, messages and teacher notes.

lt.title: Pranešimai apie naujienas
lt.text: Suplanuoti patikrinimai praneša apie naujus namų darbus, pažymius, žinutes ir įrašus.

highlights.title: Popup or notification
highlights.text: See news as a popup in Scriptable, or as a notification in the background.

lt.title: Iššokantis langas arba pranešimas
lt.text: Naujienos rodomos Scriptable lange arba kaip pranešimas fone.

highlights.title: No repeats
highlights.text: Each item is shown once, and the first check only records what's already there.

lt.title: Be pasikartojimų
lt.text: Kiekviena naujiena parodoma vieną kartą, o pirmas patikrinimas tik įsimena esamas.

changes: Run with the parameter check (Shortcuts) or ?check=1 to look for new homework, grades, messages and teacher notes
Popup alert inside Scriptable, notification in the background, same text as the Shortcut output
Opening the app also pops up anything new since the last run

releases.title: A tidier Today screen

highlights.title: One chip per subject
highlights.text: Double lessons no longer show the same subject twice under Get ready.

lt.title: Vienas dalykas – vienas ženkliukas
lt.text: Dvigubos pamokos nebesidubliuoja skiltyje „Pasiruošti“.

highlights.title: Labels kept
highlights.text: Test and project labels stay on the subject's single chip.

lt.title: Žymos išlieka
lt.text: Kontrolinių ir projektų žymos lieka prie dalyko.

highlights.title: Cleaner tests list
highlights.text: Upcoming tests appear once, even when marked on both lessons of a double.

lt.title: Tvarkingas atsiskaitymų sąrašas
lt.text: Atsiskaitymai rodomi vieną kartą, net jei pažymėti abiejose pamokose.

fixes: Get ready for…: duplicate subject chips from double lessons
Tests and checks ahead: duplicate entries for the same subject and label on one day

releases.title: Ask knows everything, and remembers

highlights.title: Ask pulls everything
highlights.text: A chat starts with all homework, grades and attendance since 1 September.

lt.title: Visi duomenys pokalbyje
lt.text: Pokalbis prasideda su visais namų darbais, pažymiais ir lankomumu nuo rugsėjo 1 d.

highlights.title: Remembers the chat
highlights.text: Follow-up questions work, and the conversation is still there tomorrow.

lt.title: Prisimena pokalbį
lt.text: Galite klausti toliau, o pokalbis išlieka ir kitą dieną.

highlights.title: 1–7 grade scale
highlights.text: Pick each child's grading scale so averages and Ask judge grades correctly.

lt.title: Skalė 1–7
lt.text: Kiekvienam vaikui pasirinkite vertinimo skalę, kad vidurkiai būtų teisingi.

changes: Ask gathers 5 weeks of lessons, homework and grades since 1 September, classwork, calendar, notices and messages
Whole conversation sent with every question and saved per child on the phone
Clear memory button (tap twice) and Refresh data
Grade scale per child (1–10, 1–7, 1–5 or custom) from the Grades tab or the ••• menu

releases.title: Ask about the school week

highlights.title: Ask in your words
highlights.text: Ask what's due, which tests are coming or what the school wrote.

lt.title: Klauskite savais žodžiais
lt.text: Klauskite, ką reikia atlikti, kokie kontroliniai artėja ar ką rašė mokykla.

highlights.title: Your key stays put
highlights.text: Your OpenAI key is saved once in the iPhone Keychain, only sent to OpenAI.

lt.title: Raktas saugus
lt.text: OpenAI raktas saugomas iPhone Keychain ir siunčiamas tik į OpenAI.

highlights.title: Lithuanian or English
highlights.text: Answers come in the language you ask in, quoting school text as written.

lt.title: Lietuviškai arba angliškai
lt.text: Atsakoma ta kalba, kuria klausiate, mokyklos tekstą cituojant tiksliai.

changes: ✨ Ask chat screen with suggested questions, using the OpenAI Responses API

releases.title: First release

highlights.title: Today on one screen
highlights.text: Current lesson, what to prepare for tomorrow, homework due and today's messages.

lt.title: Diena viename ekrane
lt.text: Dabartinė pamoka, ką paruošti rytojui, namų darbai ir šiandienos žinutės.

highlights.title: Homework by due date
highlights.text: All homework grouped by due date, with overdue work marked.

lt.title: Namų darbai pagal terminą
lt.text: Visi namų darbai sugrupuoti pagal terminą, vėluojantys pažymėti.

highlights.title: Messages per day
highlights.text: A 7-day chart of messages, grouped by day, with unread ones highlighted.

lt.title: Žinutės pagal dienas
lt.text: 7 dienų žinučių grafikas ir sąrašas pagal dienas, neperskaitytos išskirtos.

changes: Today, Schedule, Homework, Messages and Grades screens, Lithuanian and English, light and dark
Home-screen widget, offline cache, several children on one account
Credentials kept in the iOS Keychain
